en.headline: Lantau Live returns for two-day music and arts weekend in Mui Wo
en.dek: The festival's third edition runs Saturday and Sunday at The Hideout with live bands, DJs, theatre, workshops and a kids' zone.
body: Lantau Live is holding its third edition this weekend at The Hideout in Mui Wo, expanding to two full days for the first time, according to the organisers.

The event runs from 10am to 9pm on both Saturday and Sunday, with live bands, DJ sets, open-air theatre, magic shows, wellness sessions, artisan workshops, a market and a kids' fun zone. Adult day tickets are priced at HK$250 and weekend passes at HK$400, with lower rates for children under 18 and family options available.
Organisers said visitors can reach the site by ferry from Central Pier 6 to Mui Wo or via Tung Chung, and advised checking current transport times. Children under three attend free.

zh.headline: Lantau Live第三屆梅窩音樂藝術節首度兩日舉行
zh.dek: 活動周六及周日在The Hideout舉行，有現場樂隊、DJ、劇場、工作坊及兒童專區。
body: 主辦單位表示，Lantau Live第三屆本周末在梅窩The Hideout舉行，並首次擴展為兩日活動。
活動於周六及周日上午10時至晚上9時進行，包括現場樂隊、DJ表演、戶外劇場、魔術、身心健康環節、手作坊、市集及兒童專區。成人單日票250元，週末通行證400元，18歲以下小童及家庭票有較低價錢。
主辦單位指，可乘中環6號碼頭渡輪往梅窩，或經東涌前往，建議預先查詢交通時間。三歲以下小童免費入場。
